criteria.pass: candidate workflow gives both verifiers the same explicit, current bounded manifest and records provenance; removed CLI flags are absent
missing, malformed, stale, or identity-mismatched manifests fail closed; valid bounded evidence is reproducible
symlinked parent/final paths and traversal are rejected before writes; outside sentinel stays unchanged
each source has its own baseline digest and verified restoration; multi-file identity crossing cannot pass
production inventory includes owned TS and TSX, including unimported app pages, and preserves all established floors
common Playwright selection excludes real-runtime; explicit-real selection includes it and missing services cannot yield PASS
summative runtime follows an approved modality/version contract and leaves formative behavior intact, or the missing contract remains explicitly gated without invented behavior
Ricardo's approved editorial/RPO decisions are recorded and reflected; live, remote, production and content gates remain separate
current evidence identifies its checkout/worktree and hashes; historical scorecards remain historical
restore runbook states observed backup/schema/migration compatibility, ordering, validation and abort; live drill is gated
fresh integrated review and authorized verification leave no unhandled P0/P1 for claims being made; residual gaps are recorded

constraints: No production, publication, remote dispatch/push, or live external service without the matching authorization.
Synthetic data only; no secrets or real clinical/tutor records.
A missing prerequisite is NOT RUN or BLOCKED, never PASS.
Every code task follows RED -> GREEN -> REFACTOR and is independently reviewed.
